hypothesis: The all-class action-margin objective contains useful Weak4 boundary information, but its non-Weak4 gradients cause the observed ask_user/plan_task loss. Restricting only the auxiliary to true-label Weak4 rows should retain the exploration gain without changing ordinary KD elsewhere.
single_quality_variable: Set action-margin true-label scope from all teacher-covered original rows to Weak4 teacher-covered original rows.

invariants.ordinary_kd: Unchanged alpha=0.5, T=3 on every previously teacher-covered original row.
invariants.margin_candidates: Detached M8 teacher top-3 negatives over all 13 non-true classes, unchanged.
invariants.margin_strength: Deterministically recalibrate to the same target logit-gradient ratio 0.10 after applying the Weak4 scope.
invariants.replay: Legacy last1 cap=10000 weight=0.5; replay remains excluded from action-margin KD.
invariants.seed_split_serializer: seed42 fixed session split, current_v1 length384, identical to the paired control.

decision_gate.ask_user_plan_task: No recurrence of the all-class collapse.
decision_gate.required_classes: No material collapse in web_search, lint_or_typecheck, run_tests, or run_bash.

promotion: If the one-arm screen passes, apply the same scope to the reconstructed seed202 sieve x conditional-alpha recipe. Do not combine it with B-fast in the first refit.
release_policy: Never release lane A after completion; preserve the session, Drive mount, daemon, and keep-alive until the user explicitly says otherwise.

postmortem.runner_interruption: The plan parent was explicitly terminated while the child trainer survived as an orphan and continued through epoch 3.

terminal_failure.plan_bug: The plan required zero AMP skips but omitted the stabilized --amp-init-scale 64 and --amp-growth-interval 1000000 flags, leaving defaults 65536 and 2000.

control_plane_diagnosis.confirmed: Some intended lane-C manual commands used AADP_EXCHANGE instead of the supported AADP_EXCHANGE_DIR variable. cloud_sync.py therefore used its default AADP_exchange queue and acted on lane A.
control_plane_diagnosis.not_confirmed: A later exhaustive /proc environment scan found no lane-A daemon reading AADP_exchange_c. No duplicate exchange_c daemon was killed.
control_plane_diagnosis.lane_isolation_check: Lane A had only daemon PID 1150 on AADP_exchange; lane C had its own daemon PID 1573 on AADP_exchange_c and was idle at 0% GPU / 6 MiB.
control_plane_diagnosis.drive_queue_check: The actual AADP_exchange_c/cmd/done directory had no command newer than 2026-07-14T15:52Z. The later s909 refusal was therefore returned through the default A queue, not claimed from the C queue.

seed777_collision.same_recipe: Both were seed777 trio-teacher trainers with identical arguments.
seed777_collision.intervention: After explicit user authorization, orphan PID 60035 was identity-checked and SIGKILLed at 2026-07-14T18:37:20Z. Tracked trainer PID 63117 remained alive; GPU memory returned from about 23.4 GiB to 11.7 GiB.
seed777_collision.artifact_warning: Treat any seed777 output as collision-exposed until checkpoint/output provenance and file integrity are independently verified.

recovery_eval.checkpoint_integrity: 219 tensors, zero non-finite values; epoch-3 state and calibrated action-margin metadata matched the run contract

postmortem.decision: The interrupted run remains invalid for direct packaging, but its intact epoch-3 checkpoint produced a positive recovered fixed-session evaluation above both preregistered gates. Promote the hypothesis directly to a clean stabilized full refit; do not spend another A100 run on a duplicate diagnostic evaluation.
